response.sql: WITH p AS (SELECT `ANA Pattern` AS pattern, AVG(`aCL IgG`) AS avg_igg FROM Examination WHERE `ANA Pattern` IS NOT NULL GROUP BY `ANA Pattern` HAVING AVG(`aCL IgG`) IS NOT NULL), o AS (SELECT AVG(avg_igg) AS overall FROM p), a AS (SELECT p.pattern, p.avg_igg, o.overall FROM p JOIN o ON p.avg_igg > o.overall) SELECT pattern, avg_igg, avg_igg - overall AS above_overall_avg, avg_igg - (SELECT AVG(avg_igg) FROM a) AS diff_from_above_group_avg FROM a ORDER BY avg_igg DESC;

assumptions.assumption: Rows with a NULL ANA Pattern are not treated as a pattern and are excluded.
The cross-pattern average is the unweighted mean of the per-pattern averages (each pattern counts once). Patterns whose aCL IgG values are all missing have no average and are left out of that mean.

Both differences are signed: the pattern's average minus the reference average. The first is always positive. The second can be negative or positive, depending on whether the pattern is below or above the mean of the above-average patterns.
